assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Until official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are released, geometry/site_boundary.geojson and geometry/key_areas.geojson remain provisional_constraint with official_boundary=false, mirroring brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, building placement, and metrics are recomputable but must be recalculated after official polygon substitution; provisional status does not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: PH-1/PH-2/PH-3 extents and the JZ-01..JZ-10 project phasing are design-level implementation logic, not statutory commitments, funding plans, or approved government schedules.
assumptions.impact: Phasing is reviewable as design intent; statutory approval and funding paths remain to-be-confirmed risks tracked in the proposal risk chapter.

assumptions.statement: The 1,095 building footprints are synthetic design-proposal footprints generated on a 72 m metric grid inside the provisional boundary with storey counts tied to land-use codes; existing building stock, ownership, and regulatory plan conditions are not available.
assumptions.impact: buildings.geojson supports scheme-level massing and FAR discussion only; retain-renovate-demolish conclusions require official building and ownership data.
